annotations.title: Live planning constraints for a roof postcode

description: Looks up, live from official open data, what applies at the customer's postcode before a re-roof, a change of roof material, rooflights, dormers or chimney work: listed buildings, conservation areas, Article 4 directions, World Heritage Sites, National Landscapes and scheduled monuments (planning.data.gov.uk, England, councils that publish). Returns each constraint found with its source link, what it means for roof work (listed building consent, matching materials, dormers not permitted development), the council and nation, and the matching check_building_regs flags. A constraint not found is not proof of none: the answer says so. Example: {"postcode":"BA1 2LR"}.
name: property_check
title: Live planning constraints for a roof postcode
